يختتنوا (form VIII)
# يَخْتَتِنُوا (yaḵtatinū) /jax.ta.ti.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَتَنَ (iḵtatana)
# يُخْتَتَنُوا (yuḵtatanū) /jux.ta.ta.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَتَنَ (iḵtatana)
